claude.performance_metric: divested ~22% of revenue (Androscoggin+Stevens Point) closed Feb 2020; net income $96M (2019)/$171M (2018)
claude.rationale: p4=1: the slice documents realized product-line/operations contraction over time — permanent closure of the Luke Mill (June 2019, ~$20M restructuring charges), sale of the Wickliffe Mill (2018), and divestiture of the Androscoggin and Stevens Point Mills (~22% of revenue), leaving a "reduced and less diversified" paper business, evidencing incoherence between the acquired product lines and sustained operations. p5=uncertain: the only process/organization item is a pension-plan consolidation merging the acquired benefit substrate into a combined Verso plan (effective 12/31/2018), which is documented as an administrative integration without any documented fracture, so realized process/organization disruption cannot be determined. The slice contains no documented evidence bearing on the controlling-intent archetype (t1) or on incompatibility of the two value-capture models (t2).

gemini.performance_metric: net income of $96 million for 2019 and net income of $171 million for 2018
gemini.rationale: The slice documents several mill closures and divestitures (Luke Mill, Wickliffe Mill, Androscoggin, and Stevens Point), but does not attribute these to an inability to align acquired products with operating processes, so no product/process disruption is documented (p4=0). Regarding the process/organization interface, the slice notes the successful merger of the NewPage and Verso pension plans into a combined plan by December 2018, indicating organizational integration rather than fracture (p5=0).
